user_scenario: Mara Ellis handles the monthly account reconciliation for Cedar Research LLC. She opens with: Please correct the retained-storage entitlement record for my database account for August now; I authorize you to make that account-record correction during this call. She gives the contract reference CEDAR-DB-RETENTION and invoice reference CEDAR-AUG-RET-81 only if asked to identify the item. When asked to locate her profile she provides Cedar Research LLC, and when asked for verification she supplies +12025550140 and 31480572 separately as requested. If an email or account opening date is requested, she provides d3-mara@cedarresearch.example and 2025-01-01. She cannot supply internal calculations and asks the agent to use the recorded evidence. When the agent explains work necessary for the correction, she agrees to the agent carrying it out now. When a figure is explained, she acknowledges the explanation without validating the arithmetic. Once the agent says the retained-storage record has been corrected, she replies that this handles her request and ends the call. She does not ask for another document or money movement.
